title: Price and limited usage with new update
body: I am writing to express my deep disappointment regarding the recent update that limits usage to 55 times per year for a subscription that costs $300 annually. This is especially frustrating considering that the service was previously advertised and offered as unlimited under the same pricing structure. As a paying customer who subscribed in good faith based on those terms, this sudden change feels not only restrictive but also exploitative. It gives the impression that the company is prioritizing profit over user trust and long-term satisfaction. At $300 per year, users reasonably expect premium and unrestricted access. Introducing such a drastic limitation without a corresponding reduction in price or a grandfathering policy for existing subscribers undermines that expectation and reflects poorly on the company’s values. I urge you to reconsider this decision and restore the service to the original terms promised. If not, I would at least appreciate transparent communication and fair compensation options for current subscribers who feel misled by this change.
